purpose.title: Core Purpose
purpose.summary: MEDITSIIN4.0 was created to solve the slow digital development of the medical field and enable the rapid spread of remote work. While many professions have successfully adapted to flexible and remote work forms, medicine requires a thoughtful, secure, and specifically tailored approach due to its critical nature. The aim is to provide support that helps healthcare modernize without compromising quality or safety.

background.title: Background
background.intro: Many GP centers operate under increasing pressure:
background.item1: Staff shortages among doctors and nurses
background.item3: Fragmented tools for communication, scheduling, and documentation
background.item4: No dedicated IT or operational support
background.item5: Limited visibility into workload, staff wellbeing, or patient satisfaction

expectations.title: At the same time, expectations are changing.
expectations.text: Younger doctors increasingly expect flexible and remote work options, while many centers remain dependent on physical presence and manual coordination.
expectations.lackTitle: Most GP centers recognize the need to modernize, but lack:
expectations.lack3: Capacity to design secure, compliant remote setups

onboarding.title: 30-Day Onboarding
onboarding.intro: A standardized modernization package that sets up your operational foundation:

step1.title: Existing setup is mapped
step1.text: We document your current systems, devices, accounts, and workflows

step2.title: Hardware and access are provisioned centrally
step2.text: Managed devices (if needed) and identity/access baseline are set up

step3.title: Communication, scheduling, and documents are standardized
step3.text: We reduce fragmentation and clarify ownership and permissions

step4.title: Internal structure and collaborations are mapped
step4.text: Roles, responsibilities, and cross-coverage are documented

step5.title: Remote access and security rules are applied
step5.text: Least privilege, MFA, device policies, and auditability are configured

step6.title: Monitoring and reporting are activated
step6.text: Operational visibility for stability and incremental improvement

support.title: Continuous Support and Enablement
support.intro: After onboarding, the system runs continuously with ongoing support:

item1.title: Continuous monitoring and maintenance
item1.text: Proactive system monitoring ensures reliability and security without manual intervention

item2.title: Incremental improvement
item2.text: Regular updates and optimizations keep your operational foundation current and effective

item3.title: Secure remote work enablement
item3.text: Ongoing support ensures your team can work remotely securely and reliably
